thesis: Her SIGNALS framework joins demand testing, industry choice, distribution and systems.
summary: SIGNALS combines speed, industry selection, generational transfer, needs-based cash flow, affluent customers, leverage through distribution and AI systems. A trash-service presale illustrates testing willingness to pay before equipment; aging-owner anecdotes support acquisition interest. She describes iterative agent troubleshooting and human escalation, then argues scarce human attention can command a premium and asks whether the owner will want to steward the business through difficulty.

insights.title: Test willingness to pay before large fixed costs
insights.explanation: The reported trash-service story uses presales before a truck; it supports demand testing rather than bypassing obligations.
insights.quote: what I mean when I say sell first and build second
insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Consider industry conditions before novelty
insights.explanation: She focuses on necessary services and owner succession as potential opportunities; survival is not assured by category.
insights.quote: this isn't actually about being sexy it's about being solvent
insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Use a diagnostic loop with escalation
insights.explanation: The proposed agent gathers information, tries tools, evaluates results and reports failed attempts if needed.
insights.quote: the AI adjusts its approach and it changes ideas
insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Reserve human contact for consequential interactions
insights.explanation: She predicts greater value for human connection as automation spreads; this is a forecast.
insights.quote: the scarcer human touch becomes the more valuable it gets
insights.speaker: unresolved

insights.title: Ask what persists beyond the founder
insights.explanation: The ending connects business choice to legacy and willingness to stay through hard conditions.
insights.quote: what story will this business tell when I'm not here to tell it anymore
insights.speaker: unresolved

review_status: Codex editorial draft; complete local transcript read; claims not independently verified
synthesis_method: Direct Codex extraction from complete local transcript; exact quotations verified locally
context_and_limits: Failure rates vary inconsistently in the narration and are not independently checked. Aging population counts are not business-sale counts; retirement does not ensure a good deal. Preselling is not proof permits or service obligations can be skipped. Domain/SEO and AI capabilities are promotional or illustrative claims. Affluent-client pricing and future human premiums are hypotheses, not guarantees.
review_changes: Adds stewardship and human handoff, distinguishes demand evidence from operating readiness, and flags inconsistent base-rate and retirement arithmetic.
